ValidationRule.description: For CCRM - Checks if Lost Reason is not blank if Stage is Opportunity Lost For MLCRM - Checks if Lost Reason is not blank if Stage is Lost
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISCHANGED(StageName), ISBLANK(TEXT(Lost_Reason__c)), OR( AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity', ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Opportunity Lost')), AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Opportunity', ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a valid Lost Reason.
